text:
Alex: Quick postmortem follow-up — we need owners, dates, and rollback play for the GPU surge work. Scope: cloud quota request, scheduler knob experiments, 72h soak with observability, and automatic guardrails. I suggest Priya owns quota, Devon owns scheduler tests, Mika owns soak and dashboards. Agree?

Priya: I can take quota. Need exact numbers and preferred change window. Also will need the cloud case owner for escalation.

Devon: Plan: (A) dry-run (no actual quota bump) to validate scheduler dynamics, (B) controlled soak at ~80% headroom, (C) conditional quota increase only if soak stable. We'll monitor fair-share and preemption signals.

Sam: +1 on staged approach. Canary by region (use us-east first, then us-west) to reduce blast radius. Sam volunteers to own cloud support ticket escalation.

Mika: I'll own dashboards and the 72h soak orchestration. I'll add p95/p99 latency, backlog_size, preempt_rate, eviction_count, and scheduling_success_ratio panels.

Alex: Proposed timeline: plan doc due in 3 business days, dry-run next week, soak window 2025-05-02 to 2025-05-05, 24h rollback window after soak. Sound realistic?

Priya: Those dates work. I'll draft the quota request and include exact compute units and node types.

IncidentBot: Created INC-4021 (gpu-quota-request) assigned to Priya, due 2025-05-01.

Devon: Scheduler knobs to test during dry-run: `fair_share_weight=0.88` and `preempt_threshold=0.58`. Dry-run will use `scheduler.debug=true` to capture traces and will not actually change cloud quota.

Alex: Add explicit signals to check pre/post change: p99 latency, queue_length, preempt_rate, eviction_count, successful_scheduling_ratio, and fair_share_imbalance.

Mika: Alerts to add for soak: `alerts/gpu_backlog_rate > 10% for 5m` and `alerts/p99_latency > 2s for 3m`. I'll attach dashboards to the tickets.

Priya: We need a reproducible dry-run script in the runbook. Example to simulate load:

```
# simulate sustained generation load for dry-run
python tools/sim_load.py --qps 1200 --dur 3h --model model-xl --trace scheduler
```

Devon: During soak enable `scheduler.debug=true` for the first hour of each day, then disable. Keep `preempt_protection=on` for low-priority jobs. If `fair_share_imbalance` rises above 0.12 for 10m, trigger rollback.

Mika: I'll schedule a recurring 30m check-in during the 72h soak (daily 09:30). Calendar invite sent.

Alex: We must add automated rollback clauses to the tickets: thresholds, who executes, and exact rollback commands.

Priya: Draft rollback sequence: 1) revert quota change via cloud console/API, 2) rollback scheduler config to previous commit (git hash in ticket), 3) cordon & drain any ephemeral nodes, 4) notify customers. I'll add the commands and git diffs to INC-4021.

Sam: I'll own cloud-side rollback steps (revoke quota, shrink nodepool), and handle escalation to cloud support.

IncidentBot: Created INC-4022 (scheduler-experimentation) assigned to Devon, due 2025-05-02.

IncidentBot: Created INC-4023 (gpu-soak-dashboard) assigned to Mika, due 2025-05-05.

Devon: Risk note: bumping quota without validation can favor long-running low-priority jobs. We'll monitor `fair_share_imbalance` and enable an automated rollback if it exceeds threshold. Also track `preempt_rate` to detect aggressive eviction.

Alex: Add the auto-rollback clause to INC-4021 with the thresholds Devon suggested and who runs it (Sam + infra oncall).

Mika: Dashboards and alert rules added to INC-4023. Temporary alert mute policy: only escalation channel is #incidents and the soak ops channel. Link placeholder: https://redwood-internal/grafana/d/soak-gpu

Priya: I'll update the internal runbook with timeline, owners, dry-run script, and rollback commands. Will ping when INC-4021 is submitted.

Alex: Final checklist: Priya submits quota ticket, Devon posts scheduler diffs + rollback commands, Mika wires dashboards & alerts and schedules soak check-ins, Sam owns cloud support & rollback ops. Reconvene tomorrow 09:00 to confirm tickets and kickoff dry-run. :thumbsup:

Sam: Got it.

Mika: Invite accepted.

Priya: Filing INC-4021 now.

Devon: Preparing config diffs and a test harness for the dry-run.

Alex: Thanks team — appreciate the quick coordination.
